title: 辺野古転覆、生徒ら防波堤から乗船　現場視察の沖縄県議「誰が見ても危ない」
extracted_text: 沖縄県名護市辺野古沖で船2隻が転覆し、平和学習中の同志社国際高（京都府）2年の女子生徒ら2人が死亡した事故で、沖縄県議会の自民党会派は1日、生徒たちが足場の悪い防波堤から乗船していたことが判明したと明らかにした。複数の地元住民から証言を得たという。自民党会派は同日までに、事故を調査するプロジェクトチーム（PT）を立ち上げた。 PTの座長を務める仲村家治県議らが那覇市内で記者会見し、同校の生徒たちが防波堤の砕石の積まれた場所から抗議船に乗船していたとの複数の証言を得たと発表した。 自民党会派の県議らが4月21日と29日、名護市の辺野古漁港で生徒らが抗議船に乗るまでの動きを検証。防波堤の幅が50センチ程度と狭かったことや、生徒たちが乗船したとみられる砕石の積まれた場所まで約1・2メートルの高低差があったことなども判明したとしている。 仲村氏は会見で「なぜ引率の先生は乗船しなかったのか」と疑問視し、そのうえで「ああいう所から船に乗ること自体、誰が見ても危ない。引率の先生だったら止める。普通は『岸壁から乗せてください』と要求すると思う」と話した。 PTは今後、有識者や関係者からヒアリングを進め、再発防止に向けた制度の運用改善の検討などを進める方針。（大竹直樹）
translated_text: On the self-styled "peace learning" trip, two second-year female students from Doshisha International High School (Kyoto Prefecture) died when two boats capsized near Henoko in Nago City, Okinawa. On the 1st, the LDP caucus in the Okinawa Prefectural Assembly revealed that it had been confirmed the students had boarded from a breakwater with poor footing. They obtained testimony from multiple local residents. By the same day, the LDP caucus had also set up a project team (PT) to investigate the accident. Assembly member Yoshikazu Nakamura, who serves as PT chair, held a press conference in Naohe and announced that they had obtained multiple testimonies stating the students had boarded the protest boat from a spot on the breakwater where rubble was piled. The LDP caucus assembly members verified on April 21st and 29th the students' movements up until boarding the protest boat at Henoko fishing port in Nago City. They confirmed that the breakwater was narrow at only about 50 centimeters, and that there was a height difference of about 1.2 meters between where the students boarded and where the rubble was piled. At the press conference, Nakamura questioned "Why didn't the supervising teacher board the boat," adding, "Getting on a boat from a place like that—anyone can see it's dangerous. If the supervising teacher had been there, they would have stopped it. Normally, you'd ask to board from the quay." The PT plans to proceed with hearings from experts and related parties, and consider improvements to system operation to prevent recurrence. (Naoki Otake)
title_en: Henoko Capsizing: Students Board from Breakwater; Okinawa Prefectural Assembly Member Says "Anyone Can See It's Dangerous"
